items.title: Addiction and Tolerance of Caffeine (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Addiction and Tolerance of Caffeine: a main subheading of 15.7.1 Addiction, Tolerance and Withdrawal Symptoms, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 47-48.

blocks.text: Caffeine bohat se aam mashroobat (beverages), jaise coffee, chai aur energy drinks, mein hota hai. Yeh adenosine naam ke neurotransmitter ka asar rok sakta hai, jo neend aur sukoon laata hai. Nateeje mein caffeine chaukasi aur tawanai barhata hai.

Caffeine ka baqaida istemal tolerance paida kar sakta hai, is liye wahi chaukasi ke liye zyada khuraak chahiye hoti hai. Agar caffeine achanak band kar di jaye to sar dard aur thakan jaisi withdrawal symptoms ho sakti hain.
